_comment: Copy to config/staging.json (gitignored). Build with --flavor staging --dart-define-from-file=config/staging.json. Staging uses the production app ids with Google's test ads and analytics off; it goes to TestFlight internal and Play internal testing only and is never promoted to production. FIREBASE_* values come from the Firebase console (project aa-12-step-guide, Project settings > Your apps; or `flutterfire configure` output): they are public identifiers kept out of git by choice (Q-T1). Leave them empty and analytics and crash reporting stay off.
